changes.name: WaterfallPortalSystem10
changes.source:
local portal=workspace:WaitForChild("SkyboundMap"):WaitForChild("WaterfallPortal")
local prompt=portal:WaitForChild("TravelPrompt")
local destination=workspace.SkyboundMap:WaitForChild("WaterfallIsles"):WaitForChild("IslandTop")
prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
 local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats");local coins=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("SkyCoins")
 if not coins then return end
 if player:GetAttribute("WaterfallUnlocked")~=true then
  if coins.Value<10 then return end
  coins.Value-=10;player:SetAttribute("WaterfallUnlocked",true)
  prompt.ActionText="TRAVEL"
 end
 local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if root then root.CFrame=CFrame.new(destination.Position+Vector3.new(0,7,0)) end
end)

changes.name: StarterEggSystem10
changes.source:
local egg=workspace:WaitForChild("SkyboundMap"):WaitForChild("StarterEgg"):WaitForChild("Egg")
local prompt=egg:WaitForChild("HatchPrompt")
local pets={{name="Cloud Bunny",chance=60,color=Color3.fromRGB(235,245,255)},{name="Sky Fox",chance=30,color=Color3.fromRGB(100,205,255)},{name="Sun Cub",chance=9,color=Color3.fromRGB(255,205,70)},{name="Storm Dragon",chance=1,color=Color3.fromRGB(150,95,255)}}
local function roll() local r=math.random(1,100);local t=0;for _,p in ipairs(pets) do t+=p.chance;if r<=t then return p end end return pets[1] end
local function spawnPet(player,pet)
 local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");if not root then return end
 local old=workspace:FindFirstChild(player.Name.."_EquippedPet");if old then old:Destroy() end
 local oldAtt=root:FindFirstChild("PetFollowPoint");if oldAtt then oldAtt:Destroy() end
 local part=Instance.new("Part");part.Name=player.Name.."_EquippedPet";part.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball;part.Size=Vector3.new(3.5,3.5,3.5);part.Color=pet.color;part.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic;part.CanCollide=false;part.Massless=true;part.CFrame=root.CFrame*CFrame.new(4,1,3);part.Parent=workspace
 local gui=Instance.new("BillboardGui");gui.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(160,40);gui.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,2.8,0);gui.AlwaysOnTop=true;gui.Parent=part
 local label=Instance.new("TextLabel");label.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1);label.BackgroundTransparency=1;label.Text=pet.name;label.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1);label.TextStrokeTransparency=.25;label.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;label.TextScaled=true;label.Parent=gui
 local a=Instance.new("Attachment");a.Name="PetFollowPoint";a.Position=Vector3.new(4,1,3);a.Parent=root
 local b=Instance.new("Attachment");b.Parent=part
 local align=Instance.new("AlignPosition");align.Attachment0=b;align.Attachment1=a;align.MaxForce=50000;align.Responsiveness=12;align.Parent=part
end
prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
 local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats");local coins=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("SkyCoins");if not coins or coins.Value<10 then return end
 coins.Value-=10;local pet=roll();local inv=player:FindFirstChild("Pets") or Instance.new("Folder");inv.Name="Pets";inv.Parent=player
 local owned=Instance.new("StringValue");owned.Name=pet.name;owned.Value=pet.name;owned.Parent=inv;spawnPet(player,pet)
 prompt.ObjectText="HATCHED: "..pet.name;task.delay(2,function() if prompt.Parent then prompt.ObjectText="STARTER EGG" end end)
end)
